templates.description: A self-hosted dashboard that puts all your feeds in one place. Source: https://github.com/glanceapp/glance
templates.name: glance
templates.note: Glance needs a glance.yml config file in the mounted /app/config directory to start. Add one (see the project's example configuration) and restart.
templates.title: Glance

templates.description: Automated developer-oriented status page with highly configurable health checks. Source: https://github.com/TwiN/gatus
templates.name: gatus
templates.note: Mount a config.yaml into /config to define your health checks; Gatus starts with defaults if none is present.
templates.title: Gatus

templates.description: Self-hosted homelab dashboard, one container. Per-container GPU/VRAM attribution (which process holds the card, not just total load), Docker health/logs, systemd status, host vitals (CPU/RAM/disk/temps), multiple hosts over SSH. Alerts via Discord/ntfy/Telegram. Read-only MCP server on :9810. MIT. Source: https://github.com/SikamikanikoBG/homelab-monitor
templates.name: homelab-monitor
templates.title: HomeLab Monitor

templates.description: The directory page for the people you host services for: no account, multilingual, live status, one tiny container. Source: https://github.com/MorganKryze/cairn
templates.name: cairn
templates.note: Starts with no configuration at all and serves a getting-started page. Drop a services.yaml into the mounted /config directory and it reloads within seconds, no restart needed. It writes nothing at runtime, so it also runs read-only with every capability dropped.
templates.title: cairn

templates.description: Uptime and synthetic monitoring with status pages, incidents and alerts. Checks HTTP, DNS, TCP, ICMP, TLS expiry, databases, message brokers, heartbeats and headless browser scenarios. Source: https://github.com/fclairamb/solidping

env.name: SP_NODE_NAME
env.label: Node name
env.description: Worker name, lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter (3 to 21 characters). The server refuses to start without a valid one.

env.name: SP_BASE_URL
env.label: Public URL
env.description: URL people use to reach SolidPing. Used in links and notifications.

templates.name: solidping
templates.note: Open http://<your-host>:4000. First login: admin@solidping.io / solidpass, organization default. You are asked to set a new password right away. The SQLite database and uploads live in the /data volume. No secret is needed to start. Configuration: docs.solidping.io
templates.title: SolidPing
